request.prompt:
Goods: Lithium-ion battery pack 48V 20Ah
Country of origin: KR

Chosen so far: 85 Electrical machinery and equipment and parts thereof; sound recorders and reproducers; television image and sound recorders and reproducers, parts and accessories of such articles

Choose the heading that covers these goods. Options:
- 8506: Cells and batteries; primary
    contains 850650: Cells and batteries; primary, lithium
    contains 850680: Cells and batteries; primary, (other than manganese dioxide, mercuric oxide, silver oxide, lithium or air-zinc)
    contains 850690: Cells and batteries; primary, parts thereof
    contains 850610: Cells and batteries; primary, manganese dioxide
    contains 850660: Cells and batteries; primary, air-zinc
    contains 850630: Cells and batteries; primary, mercuric oxide
    contains 850640: Cells and batteries; primary, silver oxide
- 8507: Electric accumulators, including separators therefor; whether or not rectangular (including square)
    contains 850760: Electric accumulators; lithium-ion, including separators, whether or not rectangular (including square)
    contains 850780: Electric accumulators; other than lead-acid, nickel-cadmium, nickel-metal hydride and lithium-ion, including separators, whether or not rectangular (including square)
    contains 850720: Electric accumulators; lead-acid, (other than for starting piston engines), including separators, whether or not rectangular (including square)
    contains 850750: Electric accumulators; nickel-metal hydride, including separators, whether or not rectangular (including square)
    contains 850730: Electric accumulators; nickel-cadmium, including separators, whether or not rectangular (including square)
    contains 850710: Electric accumulators; lead-acid, of a kind used for starting piston engines, including separators, whether or not rectangular (including square)
    contains 850790: Electric accumulators; parts n.e.c. in heading no. 8507

Answer "none" if no option can cover these goods.

data.reason: A rechargeable lithium-ion battery pack is an electric accumulator, covered by heading 8507 (subheading 850760), not a primary cell or battery under 8506.
